title: POS System Outage Response
description: Point of Sale system outages affecting store operations
triggers: Multiple stores unable to process sales
immediate_actions: Identify scope of POS outage (single store vs multi-store)
Activate manual sales procedures if needed
investigation_steps: Check POS system status and connectivity
Verify network connectivity to affected stores
resolution_steps: Restart POS terminals following standard procedures
Implement backup POS system if available
Coordinate with store managers for manual processing
Apply POS system fixes or patches
verification: Test POS functionality at affected stores
Check inventory updates from POS transactions
special_considerations: During major retail events, P1 incidents must be escalated immediately
Store managers must not be instructed to factory-reset POS terminals
Coordinate with store operations for minimal sales disruption
Manual sales procedures may impact inventory accuracy
